description_en: Queries virus alerts detected by a virus scan on a specific server
description_zh: 查询病毒扫描具体机器扫描出的病毒告警
kebab_example: aliyun sas list-virus-scan-machine-event --current-page 1 --page-size 20 --uuid a6931624-c43e-4323-9128-a6be6ffdxxxx --operate-task-id 233886xx --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListVirusScanMachineEvent

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，显示的每页数据的最大条数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the task generated by a handling operation.
> You can call the [OperateVirusEvents](~~OperateVirusEvents~~) operation to handle alerts and generate this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
执行处置操作生成的任务ID。
> 您可以调用[OperateVirusEvents](~~OperateVirusEvents~~)接口处置告警来生成该参数
parameters.name: operate_task_id

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：

- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
parameters.name: lang
